label: Minimap Grid
author: Conky-Studio
description: Blueprint / tactical grid with optional crosshair and animated scan. Background chrome for maps or status panels.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h, cell = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}, {cell}
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1)
 local cx = 0
 while cx <= w do
  cairo_move_to(cr, x + cx, y); cairo_line_to(cr, x + cx, y + h); cairo_stroke(cr)
  cx = cx + cell
 end
 local cy = 0
 while cy <= h do
  cairo_move_to(cr, x, y + cy); cairo_line_to(cr, x + w, y + cy); cairo_stroke(cr)
  cy = cy + cell
 end
 if {crosshair} then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * 1.5)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.2)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x + w/2, y); cairo_line_to(cr, x + w/2, y + h)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x, y + h/2); cairo_line_to(cr, x + w, y + h/2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 if {scan} then
  local pos = (wall_clock() * {scan_speed}) % h
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * 0.8)
  cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y + pos, w, 2)
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
